mentions.description: Music tracking and playlist-sharing site described as 'Letterboxd for music'. It creates an abstraction over all the music streaming services so users can share playlists with anyone, regardless of which subscription they have.
mentions.audience: Music listeners who want to share playlists with anyone, regardless of what subscription they have
mentions.source_excerpt:
